entry_state: Inline transformation, occurrence matching and reduction answer different questions. Source-selected importers retain unresolved environment, native dependency and licensing evidence. The implementation chapter closes with a concrete preparation path; acceptance criteria are next.
exit_state: Acceptance separates engineering, accounting and scientific validity. Forecast protocols preserve exact information availability, whole-package extraction and finite reconstruction targets. Conditional financial prediction now begins with a fixed reported target and equal-information comparators.
findings: The conformance table includes balanced-but-economically-wrong counterexamples, unresolved solvers and retained alternatives.
DSL evaluation compares against a typed Python API on the same IR; small pilots cannot establish superiority.
Forecast protocols distinguish candidate rejection from experiment invalidity and require common information boundaries.
The purposive nine-issuer panel and31 pilot annotations remain development material; uncertain availability and partly elapsed forecast periods are not silently admitted.
